text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Abdelatif Filali says peace process in the Middle East is deadlocked.
- Congolese Prime Minister David Charles Ganao starts official visit to Morocco.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri tells private channel 2M new laws on constitutional reform are open to discussion and proposals.
- World Bank report saying Morocco could suffer from scarce water by the year 2020 makes it necessary to devise national water plan.
- Government prepares new laws to implement constitutional reform.
- Moroccans seeking hope still try to cross Gibraltar straits illegally to reach Europe despite danger.
